consumer.decision: May consume official FACTUAL opportunity and company-fit facts. extra-cli never emits INDEX. DATA_READY is not permission to index. web-cfg owns every editorial, INDEX, SEO and CTA decision. UNKNOWN is never treated as zero. Historical adherence is never eligibility, habilitação, capacity, recommendation or a prediction of award.

wedge.label: Fan-in of live opportunity facts and public contractual history into a consumer-bound FACTUAL pack
wedge.reuse: Adapters bind existing producer families; this projection does not crawl, re-identify, rescore or recompute the producer's canonical facts

live_opportunity.notes: valor is the declared public estimate carried by the source document. It is not a CONFENGE price, quote, fee or offer, and it is never rendered next to a commitment word.

identity.derivation: consumer-side digest of the visitor-supplied CNPJ (scripts/conversion/cnpj.cjs hashCnpj)
identity.note: The payload never carries a raw CNPJ. The consumer never builds a second identity model; the digest is a lookup key, not an identifier the producer resolves.

data_state.owner: extra-cli emits only DATA_*; editorial INDEX is owned by the consumer

as_of: source_as_of declared by the producer export; never wall-clock

freshness.generated_at: declared export timestamp from the input payload; never wall-clock
freshness.stale_rule: generated_at minus source_as_of exceeds max_age_hours, or source_as_of is unparseable
invalidation_triggers: opportunity identity, objeto, valor, prazo or status changes after source_as_of
the source document set of an opportunity changes after source_as_of
public contractual history of a company_digest changes after source_as_of
freshness.invalidation_scope: only the affected opportunity_id / company_digest payloads
freshness.refresh: re-run python3 -m scripts.live_intelligence.consume; no new scheduler, no crawler

value_semantics.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; absence of evidence is never zero
not: a CONFENGE price, fee, quote or offer

adherence_semantics.definition: Adherence describes overlap between the public contractual history of a company_digest and the declared attributes of an opportunity.
adherence_semantics.disclaimer_pt: Aderência histórica não é habilitação, capacidade nem recomendação. Os dados descrevem o histórico público declarado nas fontes citadas e podem estar incompletos.

catalog_mode.fixture: labeled fixture; never consumed or labeled as live
catalog_mode.official_live: only when producers are live official artifacts and claimed_live is true

fixture_schema.note: Structurally distinct from the live schema. It is rejected by schema negotiation and by the fixture-catalog guard, so a fixture can never be projected as live and can never reach PUBLISHABLE_INDEX.

publication.index_requires: a declared family in data/organic/public-family-registry.json plus the full editorial gate; W1 declares none and ships noindex

branding: truth plane and export are source-agnostic; brand marks and internal repo jargon are forbidden in public consumer fields
